articles.text: COMRADE WÁNG: Oh, you're going out!
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ xiǎng chūqu mǎi jǐběn shū. Láojià, nǎr yǒu mài shūde?
MR. ANDERSON: I thought I'd go out to buy a few books. Excuse me, where is there a place to buy books?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Wángfǔjǐng Dàjiē yǒu yíge Xīnhuá Shūdiàn, hěn dà.
COMRADE WÁNG: There's a New China Bookstore on Wángfǔjǐng Boulevard that's very large.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Xīnhuá Shūdiàn lí zhèr yuǎn ma? Zǒuzhe qù kěyi ma?
MR. ANDERSON: Is the New China Bookstore far from here? Is it possible to walk there?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Bù yuǎn, hěn jìn. Zǒuzhe qù kěyi.
COMRADE WÁNG: It's not far; it's very close. You can walk there.
MR. ANDERSON: How do I go?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Cóng dàmén chūqu, cháo běi guǎi, jiù shi Wángfǔjǐng Dàjiē.
COMRADE WÁNG: Go out the entrance, turn to the north, and that's Wángfǔjǐng Boulevard.
MR. ANDERSON: How far do I go?
